q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT T1.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT(T1.FOLLOWER)) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT(FOLLOWER) FROM FOLLOW) AS T2 ON T1.FOLLOWEE = T2.FOLLOWER GROUP BY T1.FOLLOWEE
